description: The line plot titled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = small" illustrates the performance of different configurations of the Whisper model over a series of epochs. The x-axis, labeled "epoch," is linear and ranges from 0 to 6, with tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis, labeled "WER," is also linear and ranges from 25.0 to 42.5, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The plot includes four lines representing different configurations: "small AdaLoRA_int4" (solid line with circle markers), "small AdaLoRA_int8" (dashed line with square markers), "small int4" (dotted line with circle markers), and "small" (solid line with square markers). The "small AdaLoRA_int4" line starts at a WER of approximately 35.0 and ends at around 30.0, showing a general decline over the epochs. The "small AdaLoRA_int8" line begins at about 40.0 and ends near 30.0, also indicating a downward trend. The "small int4" line starts at roughly 30.0 and ends at about 25.0, with a consistent decrease. Lastly, the "small" line begins at approximately 35.0 and ends at around 30.0, following a similar downward trajectory.
